mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_report ( session_id, agent_id, alert_content, root_cause, remediation, evidence, summary, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{alertContent}, #{rootCause}, #{remediation}, #{evidence}, #{summary}, #{status}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, agent_id, alert_content, root_cause, remediation, evidence, summary, status, create_time, update_time FROM diagnosis_report WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, session_id, agent_id, alert_content, root_cause, remediation, evidence, summary, status, create_time, update_time FROM diagnosis_report WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, session_id, agent_id, alert_content, root_cause, remediation, evidence, summary, status, create_time, update_time FROM diagnosis_report ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 50
